claims.citation: New York Herald, 3 June 1866, p. 2, col. 3
claims.verbatim:
Bark Henry Adderly (Br), Hartman, London, 62 days, with
mdse and 9 passengers, to E E Morgan & Son. Had heavy
westerly gales in the Channel and until reaching the Banks,
from thence had westerly and SW winds and fog.

claims.citation: Lloyd's List, 18 June 1866, p. 3, col. 3 (British Newspaper Archive)

claims.verbatim:
Bark Henry Adderly (Br.), Hartman, London 62 days, with mdse.
